journal:
# Sami's journal (p18) — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup screen: Height and Age boxes had no hint inside, only the label above. Okay once I found them.
- There is a "Pregnant or breastfeeding" tick box even after I chose Male formula. A bit odd for me, but harmless.
- Did not know what "BIA scale" meant under body fat. I have no body fat number so I left it empty.
- "Have you been eating at your current intake for 2+ weeks?" — I said Yes, I eat the same as always.
- After saving, my weight 87.9 was already put in. Good, I did not have to type it twice.
- Tape screen is good: it has 1st / 2nd / 3rd boxes for waist, exactly how I measure. It showed waist 104.3 (average). Nice.
- Home page says Body Fat "—" and "Not enough data yet", even though I gave neck + waist. I had to tap "full breakdown" to find "US Navy tape estimate: 28.5 % body fat". Why is that not on the front card? Confusing: the front says no data, the inside says 28.5 %.
- The breakdown text is long: "average of your first 3 and last 3 readings from the same source, at least 21 days apart". So I must wait 3+ weeks and have 6 readings before it tells me about my belly. Okay, but hard to read.
- Nutrition page at first said target "2,080 maintain". I did not know I had to choose "Lose" myself. Found it under the little ⚙ gear. After "Lose" it says 1,730 kcal.
- Then a long message: "The math gives 1626 ... below the minimum ... (1734 ...) The target is set to 1734". The big number says 1,730 and the text says 1734. Which one? Small thing, but I read slowly and it made me stop.
- "2,080 ± 490" — plus or minus 490 is a big range. And "0% from your data · 95% range". I don't understand the 95%.
- Food log: after breakfast it said "Macros add up to ~563 kcal (16% from the logged calories). One of the numbers may be off." I copied the numbers from my app/labels. I don't know which one is wrong. I left it.
- The "Day complete" box — I understand: tick it when I finished eating for the day. Ticked it after dinner. Day total 2,099 kcal.
- Water events (High salt, Refeed...) — not for me, skipped.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- No weigh-in today. Logged 4 meals, 2,197 kcal. Ticked Day complete.
- Every time I close the food box I land back on Nutrition. Fine.
- "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" — today is my 2nd day and it still says day 1. Maybe because it only updates on Sunday. Confusing.
- New line: "Protein averaged 117 g ... vs a 158 g target." 158 g protein is a lot for me. I eat normal food. I don't know how I would get that much. Before I chose "Lose" the protein line said 141 g.
- I'm eating ~2,100–2,200, app says 1,730. That's like cutting one whole meal. I'll see what it says on Sunday.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- Yogurt & granola: I don't know the macros, only calories. The app let me put only calories. Good.
- But after that the day total only shows "2193 kcal", no more protein/carbs/fat. And the protein line on Nutrition still says "on 2 logged day(s)" — so today is left out of protein because one meal had no macros. I understand after thinking, but nobody told me.
- "3 of the last 7 days are marked complete ... just with a wider range." I have ticked every day I used the app. It sounds like I did something wrong. I did not.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- Weighed 87.0. I tapped the word "Weight" on the home page and it opened a chart, not a place to type. The add button is "+ Weight" lower down. Small confusion.
- The weight box asks "Measured with: BIA scale / DEXA / Calipers". My scale is a normal bathroom scale. None of these is me. BIA scale was already chosen so I left it. I hope that is okay.
- Home shows "▼ 0.9 kg" and "Trend weight 87.7". Nice to see a down arrow, but I know one weigh-in is not much.
- Dinner was pasta, lower day today: 1,810 kcal. Average intake shows 2,075.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- Oats with milk: I only knew calories and protein. App took it fine and still counted my protein (4 logged days now). Good.
- 2,177 kcal today. Pizza.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- Weighed 87.5 (up from 87.0). Home now says "▼ 0.4 kg" — I think compared with my first day. There's "vs First / vs Last" at the top; I left it on First. The trend 87.6 is calmer than the scale; I like that.
- 2,267 kcal today.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 1,718 kcal today. 7 of 7 days complete. Average intake 2,066.

## Week 1 (checked Sat 2026-10-10, evening)
- App says: maintenance 2,080 ± 490 kcal/day, "Estimated", "0% from your data". Target 1,730 (lose 0.5%/week, "at minimum"). Warning: math gives 1626 but the app will not go below 1734 (my BMR). Protein 112 g average vs 158 g target. Weight trend 87.6 kg (from 87.9). Body composition: "Not enough data yet"; Navy tape estimate 28.5% only inside the breakdown.
- "Explain the math" — I opened it. Kalman filter, MAD, Hall 2008, Mifflin-St Jeor, φ = 0.6... This is for engineers, not for me. The only thing I understood: "Sedentary × 1.2 = 2,081". So the 2,080 is just a formula, not from me yet ("0% from your data").
- What I understand: I burn about 2,080 a day; to lose I should eat about 1,730. I eat about 2,070 now, so I am only a little under what I burn.
- Nothing tells me yet if my BELLY is going down. The waist card only shows one number (104.3).
- Decision: try to eat about 1,750 a day from tomorrow — smaller lunch and dinner, fewer snacks. (plan 1750)

## Day 8 (Sun) — from here I use my routine script (still taps and types through the app)
- Weighed 87.2. Tape: waist 103.6 / 102.6 / 104.3 → app shows 103.5. Neck 40.4, hips 105.5.
- Sunday update happened: maintenance now 2,120 ± 480, "5% from your data". Target still 1,730. Weight change "-0.06 kg/week, 95%: -0.53 to 0.42". So it can't even say if I'm going up or down. OK, it's early.
- The waist number on the home page has NO arrow or change, but weight has "▼ 0.7 kg". For me the waist is the most important! I had to tap the Waist circle to see a little chart: 104.3 → 103.5. The chart makes 0.8 cm look like a big drop (the scale starts at 103.5).
- Waist chart side numbers: 104.5, 104.3, 104, 103.8, 103.5 — uneven steps, looks strange.
- First day on 1,750 plan: 1,801 kcal.

## Week 2 (checked Sat 2026-10-17)
- Scale: 86.9 (Wed), 86.5 (Fri). Home: "▼ 1.4 kg", trend 87.2. Good feeling.
- Nutrition (numbers from last Sunday's update): maintenance 2,120 ± 480, Estimated, 5% from my data. Target 1,730, lose 0.5%/wk, "at minimum". Weight change still -0.06 kg/week (-0.53 to 0.42) — that is last Sunday's number, not this week. Avg intake this week 1,707.
- Protein 108 g vs 158 g target. It keeps telling me, but it doesn't tell me which food to eat. I'll not chase it.
- New text I found: "It becomes Measured once your weigh-ins and complete food days carry at least half the weight — typically 3–5 weeks." OK, so wait.
- Recent entries list at the bottom of Body shows everything, clear. Food list shows each day with "complete". Clear.
- Still nothing plain like "your belly is going down". Waist not measured this week yet (I do it Sundays).
- Decision: keep eating ~1,750. It's working on the scale. No plan change.
- CORRECTION (day 15): the waist DOES have an arrow (▼ 0.8) under the circle — I just had to scroll a little. On my small phone the arrows for the tape circles are below the fold. Still, I only saw it after 2 weeks.

## Week 3 (checked Sat 2026-10-24)
- Sunday tape (day 15): waist ~103, "▼ 1.3" vs first. Neck ▲ 0.1, hips ▼ 0.8. Weight 85.7 → 85.8 → 85.2. Home "▼" about 2.7 kg from first.
- Nutrition (Sunday 10-18 update): "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.80 kg to +0.02 kg per week) includes your target of −0.43 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,840 kcal/day." Maintenance 2,290 ± 430, Estimated, 24% from my data. Target 1,840, lose 0.5%/wk (the "at minimum" warning is gone).
- What I understood: I'm doing fine. The app thinks I burn more than it first said (2,290 instead of 2,080), so I can eat a bit more: 1,840.
- Confusing: "rate −0.80 to +0.02 includes your target" — plus 0.02 means I could be gaining? But it says On track. I just take "On track" and move on.
- Avg intake last week 1,595 — I am eating less than my plan without trying.
- Body composition: still "Not enough data yet ... needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 3". Navy estimate 27.6% now (was 28.5%) — that's the plain answer I want, but it's hidden inside and "isn't used in the calculations".
- Decision: follow the app — eat about 1,840 from tomorrow (plan 1840).

## Week 4 (checked Sat 2026-10-31)
- Scale: 85.5, 84.5, 84.2. Waist (Sun 10-25) still "▼ 1.3" vs first. Hips ▼ 1.7. Neck ▲ 0.5 (neck growing? strange, probably my tape).
- Nutrition (10-25 update): "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.04 to −0.36 kg per week) includes your target of −0.43 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,930." Maintenance 2,370 ± 360, Estimated, 46% from my data. Avg intake 1,815. Weight change −0.70 kg/week.
- I understood: I am losing, maybe even faster than needed, so the app lets me eat more again. Every week it goes up: 1,730 → 1,840 → 1,930. A bit strange: I thought to lose the belly I have to eat LESS, but the app keeps giving me MORE. I'll trust it since the scale is going down.
- Body composition still "Not enough data yet (have 4)". Navy 27.4%. It's week 4 and there's still no plain sentence about my belly.
- Decision: follow the app, ~1,930 (plan 1930).

## Week 5 (checked Sat 2026-11-07)
- Scale: 84.7, 85.2, 85.0 — went up a bit this week. Home "▼ 2.9 kg", trend 85.2.
- Sunday tape (11-01): waist 102.1, "▼ 2.1" vs first! Neck ▼ 0.4, hips ▼ 0.3. That makes me happy — belly is going down. But I had to scroll to find it and read small arrows.
- A yellow bar: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup ... Back up now / Later". I pressed Back up now → "Your data" page → "Full backup (JSON)". A file downloaded. OK. (It said "30+ days since your last backup" though I never made one — it's fine.) "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — I don't know what that means or what to do.
- Nutrition (11-01 update): "Your estimated rate (−1.04 to −0.48 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −0.43 kg/week. Eating about 340 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,050." Maintenance 2,480 ± 300, now "Measured", 63% from my data. Avg intake 1,990, −0.76 kg/week.
- What I understood: I'm losing too fast, so eat more. The target keeps going up every week: 1,730 → 1,840 → 1,930 → 2,050. Now it's about what I ate at the start before the diet! Hard to believe I can eat like before and still lose the belly. But the app says "Measured" now so maybe it knows better than the formula.
- The sentence "doesn't include your target" — I had to read it 3 times. It sounds like a problem, but it's actually good news (losing faster). The app should say plainly "You are losing faster than planned".
- Body composition breakdown: "have 5" readings, still "Not enough data yet". Navy estimate 27.4%.
- Decision: follow the app, about 2,050 (plan 2050). A bit nervous.

## Week 6 (checked Sat 2026-11-14)
- FINALLY the home card says: "Body composition — medium confidence — Losing fat". This is what I wanted from day 1! Inside: "Fat signals are down. Waist (tape) first 3: 103.6 → last 3: 102.2, −1.4 cm, noise ± 1. Weight 87.5 → 84.9, −2.6 kg. Confidence medium, based on your waist trend." Very clear. I'm happy. Navy estimate 26.4%.
- It took 5 weeks (it needs 3 readings at each end, 21 days apart). Long wait for a weekly measurer, but I understand why now.
- Body Fat / Fat Mass / Muscle Mass circles on the front are still "—" even though the app knows the Navy 26.4%. Those three empty circles take the best space on the screen and are always empty for me.
- Scale: 85.2, 84.5, 84.9. Waist ▼ 2.8 cm vs first on the tape card.
- Nutrition (11-08 update): "On track. rate −0.69 to −0.21 kg/week includes target −0.43. Suggested 1,930." Maintenance 2,360 ± 250, Measured, 73% from data. Avg intake 2,171 (I overshot my 2,050 some days, 2,664 and 2,497 — family dinners).
- Last week it said 2,050, now 1,930 again. Up, up, up, then down. I follow whatever it says, but it makes me feel it's guessing.
- Decision: back to ~1,930 (plan 1930).

## Week 7 (checked Sat 2026-11-21)
- Scale: 83.3 (!), 83.3, 84.4. Home "▼ 3.5 kg", trend 84.3.
- Sunday tape (11-15): waist ▼ 2.1 vs first — last week it said ▼ 2.8, so this week's waist was a bit bigger. Navy estimate went UP: 26.4% → 27.3%. That worried me for a minute. But the card still says "Losing fat, medium confidence"; waist first 3 → last 3: 103.6 → 101.9 (−1.6 cm), weight 87.5 → 83.7. OK, I understand: one measurement can be off, the average is what counts. The app explained "Noise ± 1" which helps.
- Nutrition (11-15 update): "On track. rate −0.55 to −0.12 kg/wk includes target −0.42. Suggested 1,990." Maintenance 2,420 ± 220, Measured, 79% from my data. Avg intake 1,739, −0.33 kg/week.
- Decision: 1,990 vs my 1,930 — only 60 kcal, a date or two. I'm not changing anything. Keep ~1,930.

## Week 8 (checked Sat 2026-11-28)
- Scale: 84.0, 83.3, 83.3. Home "▼ 4.6 kg", trend 83.9. Waist ▼ 2.3 vs first. Card still "Losing fat, medium". Waist avg 103.6 → 101.9 (−1.7). Navy 27%.
- Nutrition (11-22 update): "On track. rate −0.84 to +0.31 kg per week includes target −0.42. Suggested 1,990." Maintenance 2,420 ± 230, Measured 78%. Avg intake 1,988, −0.26 kg/week.
- Strange: last week the range was −0.55 to −0.12, now it's −0.84 to +0.31 — wider after one more week of data. "+0.31" means maybe gaining? And still "On track". I don't know what to believe; I look at the waist card instead.
- Some days I ate 2,240–2,350 (weekend family). Avg is right at 1,990 anyway.
- Decision: no change, keep ~1,930–1,990.

## Week 9 (checked Sat 2026-12-05)
- Scale: 83.7, 83.5, 82.8 — under 83! Home "▼ 5.1 kg", trend 83.6.
- Waist circle says "▼ 3.5" (vs first), but the breakdown says waist "−1.9 cm" (first 3 vs last 3). Two different numbers for the same belly. Which one do I tell my wife? I think 3.5 is today vs day 1, and 1.9 is the average of the old 3 vs new 3. The app does not say this next to the numbers.
- Still "medium confidence" after 9 weeks, even though every week the waist keeps going down. What do I need for "high"? Not said.
- Nutrition (11-29 update): "On track. rate −0.85 to +0.03 includes −0.42. Suggested 1,990." Maintenance 2,420 ± 240, Measured 76%. Avg 1,724, −0.41 kg/week.
- Protein 101 g vs 151 g. I gave up on this one.
- Decision: no change.

## Week 10 (checked Sat 2026-12-12)
- Scale: 83.1, 83.1, 82.6. Home "▼ 5.3 kg". Waist circle 101.1 "▼ 3.2". Hips ▼ 2.9, neck ▼ 0.7.
- Breakdown: "Losing fat, medium". Waist avg 103.6 → 101.3 (−2.3 cm), weight 87.5 → 82.9 (−4.5 kg). Navy 27%. (Navy number jumps around 26.4–27.4 while my waist keeps going down, so I don't look at it.)
- Backup reminder again ("30+ days"). Tapped Back up now → Full backup (JSON). Easy.
- Nutrition (12-06 update): "On track. rate −0.78 to −0.30 includes −0.42. Suggested 1,980." Maintenance 2,400 ± 240, Measured 76%. Avg 1,910, −0.54 kg/week.
- Decision: no change. The app says On track every week now, which is nice and plain.

## Week 11 (checked Sat 2026-12-19)
- Scale: 81.6 (lowest!), 81.2, 82.0. Home "▼ 5.9 kg", trend 82.4. Waist ▼ 3.8 vs first, hips ▼ 3.7.
- Breakdown: "Losing fat, medium". Waist avg 103.6 → 100.8 (−2.8 cm). Weight 87.5 → 81.6 (−5.9). Navy estimate 27.1% — it was 28.5% at the start. My weight is down 6 kg and waist nearly 4 cm but the "body fat %" moved only 1.4 points. That doesn't feel right to me; I trust the waist more.
- Nutrition (12-13 update): "On track. −0.78 to −0.38 includes −0.41. Suggested 1,980." Maintenance 2,400 ± 210, Measured 82%. Avg 1,977, −0.58 kg/week.
- Decision: no change.

## Week 12 (checked Sat 2026-12-26, last day)
- Scale: 81.7, 81.6, 83.0 (Friday after a big family lunch). Home "▼ 4.9 kg" (it uses today's 83.0), trend 82.2. Waist 100.3, ▼ 3.9 vs first. Hips ▼ 3.1.
- Breakdown: "Losing fat, medium confidence". Waist first 3 103.6 → last 3 100.6, change "−2.9 cm". (103.6 − 100.6 is 3.0 in my head — rounding, I guess.) Weight 87.5 → 82.1. Navy 26.4%.
- Nutrition (12-20 update): "On track. −0.67 to −0.29 includes −0.41. Suggested 2,000." Maintenance 2,410 ± 200, Measured 83%. Avg 1,976, −0.48 kg/week.

## End tasks: backup and export
- Tapped ⇩ at the top → "Your data": 36 weigh-ins, 12 measurement entries, 336 food entries, 84 complete days. Last backup 2026-12-12.
- Full backup (JSON) → bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json. I opened it: lots of { } and long numbers like "id": 1791085819259001, times in "Z". Not for me to read, but my data is in there (weights, waist 3 readings, meals).
- Daily data export: chose "All data" → "Export daily data (JSON)" → bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. One block per day with weight, tape, calories, protein. Readable-ish. The screen says "for spreadsheets" but it only gives JSON — I can't open JSON in Excel easily. I wanted a CSV/Excel for this.
- Measurements CSV: opens as a table (good) but the waist column has numbers like 104.26666666666667 and 101.10000000000001. Ugly. The "waist_readings_cm" column is nice (my 3 tries).
- Timestamps: backup says exportedAt "…18:30:20Z" while the daily export says "…21:30:21+03:00". Same moment, two styles. Not important for me.

## Final review
- What helped: The tape screen with 1st/2nd/3rd waist boxes is exactly how I measure — it did the average for me. After 5 weeks the front card said in plain words "Losing fat — medium confidence", and the breakdown showed waist first 3 vs last 3 (−2.9 cm) and weight (−5.4 kg). That is the answer I wanted. "On track" each week was simple and calming. Logging meals is quick, and "Day complete" is easy. Backup reminder came by itself.
- What confused me: I had to find "Lose" under a small gear — at first the app set me to "maintain". The target went up every week (1,730 → 1,840 → 1,930 → 2,050) and then down (1,930) — I followed it but felt it was guessing. Sentences like "your estimated rate (−1.04 to −0.48) doesn't include your target" — I needed three reads; say "you are losing faster than planned". "Explain the math" is for engineers (Kalman, MAD, φ). "Measured with: BIA scale / DEXA / Calipers" — my plain bathroom scale is not in the list. The waist arrow is below the fold on my phone; the top of the screen shows three empty circles (Body Fat, Fat Mass, Muscle Mass) that are always "—" for me, even though the app knows my Navy body fat %. Two numbers for the waist change (▼ 3.9 on the circle, −2.9 in the breakdown) with no words saying why. Protein target 150+ g every week, never told how.
- Complaints: 5 weeks before any belly answer; "medium confidence" never became "high" and it never said what's needed. The rate range sometimes got wider (−0.84 to +0.31) and still said "On track". Daily export only JSON. Long decimals in the CSV.
- Would I keep using it? Yes — my waist went from 104.3 to 100.3 and weight from 87.9 to about 82, and the app told me "Losing fat". I'd like it simpler.

# p18 (Sami, 50, M, 176 cm, 88 kg, plain scale + tape) — final report

## 1. Usage
- Used the app all 84 days (2026-10-04 → 2026-12-26). Meals logged: 336 (4/day). Days marked complete: 84/84. Weigh-ins: 36. Tape entries: 12 (every Sunday, waist ×3 + neck + hips).
- Result: weight 87.9 → 83.0 on the last scale reading (trend 82.2); waist 104.3 → 100.3 cm. Days 1–7 done by hand; from day 8 I used my own script (tests/personas/run3/out/p18/sami.mjs), which taps and types through the app, checks the day total and the "complete" tick, and stops on anything unusual. I checked the screens myself every 7 days.

## 2. Weekly table
| week | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation (short) | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (d7) | 2,080 ± 490 | 1,730 (floor "at minimum") | Estimated 0% | Suggested 1,730; math gave 1,626 but floored at BMR 1,734; on-track check needs 14 days | plan 1750 |
| 2 (d14) | 2,120 ± 480 | 1,730 | Estimated 5% | same; −0.06 kg/wk (−0.53..+0.42) | kept |
| 3 (d21) | 2,290 ± 430 | 1,840 | Estimated 24% | On track (−0.80..+0.02 incl. −0.43) | plan 1840 |
| 4 (d28) | 2,370 ± 360 | 1,930 | Estimated 46% | On track (−1.04..−0.36) | plan 1930 |
| 5 (d35) | 2,480 ± 300 | 2,050 | Measured 63% | Rate doesn't include target; eat ~340 more | plan 2050; made a backup |
| 6 (d42) | 2,360 ± 250 | 1,930 | Measured 73% | On track; body comp: "Losing fat, medium" first appears | plan 1930 |
| 7 (d49) | 2,420 ± 220 | 1,990 | Measured 79% | On track (−0.55..−0.12) | kept |
| 8 (d56) | 2,420 ± 230 | 1,990 | Measured 78% | On track (−0.84..+0.31) | kept |

## 5. Review (Sami)
The 3-box waist entry is exactly how I measure. After five weeks the app finally told me in plain words, "Losing fat". My waist went from 104 to 100 cm, and that is what kept me going. The numbers talk too much like engineers. The calorie target kept moving up and down, the waist result is hidden below empty body-fat circles, and it took 5 weeks before it said anything about my belly. It should just say "your belly is shrinking" on the front page.
Would keep using: **yes**.
